 		case CQE_TX_VPORT_IDX_OUT_OF_RANGE:
 		case CQE_TX_VPORT_DISABLED:
 		case CQE_TX_VLAN_TAGGING_VIOLATION:
-			WARN_ONCE(1, "TX: CQE error %d: ignored.\n",

 			break;
 
 		default:

+			break;
 		}
 
 		if (WARN_ON_ONCE(txq->gdma_txq_id != completions[i].wq_num))
